Team —

Quick ask from Finance ahead of Friday's commit: we need cleaned ACV and stage assignments for all Q3 expansion candidates flagged as "likely" or "best case". Brightline is one of the top upside accounts. Please do the following by EOD Thursday Pacific:

Thanks,
